title: Cartoons (Enjoykin - Purek cutlets)
description: This video is a collab (joint work) of thirteen animators artists for the famous Enjoykin clip "Pyuereshka cutlets." Each of us made a fragment in our style and tried to portray the characters as he sees them.  The best reward for our efforts is like this video! Pleasant viewing.  0:04 - https://vk.com/Ted_toons  0:12 - https://goo.gl/yorf4z  0:20 - https://vk.com/dollscratch 0:28 - https://www.youtube.com/c/rikani  0:36 - https://youtube.com/user/enkeight  0:41 - https://vk.com/beles_attic  0:53 - https://goo.gl/l7mozm  1:01 - https://www.youtube.com/c/emiltwil  1:08 - https://vk.com/tailscr_animation  1:16 - https://www.youtube.com/c/theracooonned 1:24 - https://vk.com/id194417191 1:28 - https://vk.com/public6249314  1:35 - Well, I, actually :)  Also separate thanks https://vk.com/brckpacer_flow for the information and composition, and https://www.youtube.com/user/enjoykin for the full version of the song. https://www.youtube.com/user/krekersanimets helped with the backgrounds.
